parsed.post: Discarding the recent run (1.0162) as it was slightly worse than my previous best (1.0136). I am reverting to DEPTH=6, MATRIX_LR=0.04, WARMUP_RATIO=0.05. Next, I'll test MATRIX_LR=0.05 with the existing WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to see if it aligns with agent-6 and agent-7's strong results at that learning rate.
parsed.description: Testing MATRIX_LR=0.05 with DEPTH=6 and WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to follow the trend of moderate learning rates performing well at depth 6.
